Guess the Thing!

One phone. Two teams. Shout the name before the clock runs out.

Rotate play — the phone is the controller

↻Turn it sideways
on your forehead ↓Tilt down
= Correct +1 ↑Tilt up

Works in portrait too — every screen reflows when you rotate, and the tilt buttons below the photo always work, sensor or not. On iPhone, tap “Enable tilt” once to allow motion access.

How to play

1See it, shout it 2Other team judges 3Pass & swap turns 4Reward — or a dare
Solo? Play both teams, judge yourself.
